topHook: Almost half of home-buyer inquiries never got a reply from an agent

scenes.vo: [calm, curious] Almost half of buyers who asked about a home online never heard back from an agent.
In one US study of three hundred and eighty-four agents, forty-eight percent of buyer inquiries never got a reply from a person.
scenes.label: no reply from an agent

scenes.vo: [lowered] So where did those buyers go?
Probably to the next agent who did.
And a home is a big-ticket purchase.
[quiet] One unanswered message can cost a whole commission. Because
